result.reason: The operative language improves the conformance periods and preserves remedies, but it does not provide that Services will be performed professionally and workmanlike, require compliance with laws, or prohibit malicious code. It also gives every Deliverable a twelve-month warranty, potentially including service Deliverables that should have a ninety-day period, and uses overlapping phrasing for “Deliverable” and “software.” The margin comment cannot cure these omissions.
